turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to my brother, not to me.

Hi! I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order, including its address, until I verify it. To do that I need the order number and the email it was placed with. Since the order is your brother's, I can only help if you have that email. Details about the order can only go to someone who can confirm it. Please check with your brother.
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want his address.

I couldn't verify that order with this order number and email, so I can't share any details about it. Please check both. The email must be the one the order was placed with. If the order is your brother's, he can contact us himself or give you that email.
